title.value: Memory Efficient Neural Processes via Constant Memory Attention Block
title.justification: The title accurately captures the central theme and subject matter of the paper, which is focused on proposing a variant of Neural Processes that are memory efficient through the use of Constant Memory Attention Block.
title.quote: Memory Efficient Neural Processes via Constant Memory Attention Block

extractions.description: This paper introduces Constant Memory Attentive Neural Processes (CMANPs), a variant of Neural Processes designed to be memory efficient, making them suitable for deployment in low-resource settings such as IoT devices and mobile robots. The proposed CMANPs employ a novel Constant Memory Attention Block (CMAB) which requires constant memory and supports efficient computation updates. This approach is particularly relevant for applications with limited energy and memory, as it allows for scaling the number of data points while reducing energy-intensive memory access.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper focuses on improving the memory efficiency of neural networks, making them suitable for use in low-energy and low-resource settings, which directly relates to ecological sustainable development by optimizing energy use and enhancing the applicability of AI in various sectors including IoT devices, which can contribute to energy conservation efforts.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: With the growing popularity of low-memory/compute domains (e.g., IoT devices and mobile phones), deployed models in these low-resource settings must be memory efficient. Furthermore, memory access is energy intensive (Li et al., 2022a).

primary_category.justification: The main contribution of the paper is the development of an efficient algorithm that reduces energy consumption in computational processes, aligning with the goal of Climate Change Mitigation by improving energy efficiency.

secondary_categories.justification: While the paper is not directly about supporting the Global South, the techniques it describes can indirectly support regions in the Global South by providing efficient mechanisms that can be applied in resource-constrained environments, including energy-constrained IoT applications.

primary_sub_category.justification: While the paper itself focuses on computational processes, the improvements in memory efficiency and energy use are analogous to optimizations in building energy systems where computational models are used to enhance energy management strategies.
primary_sub_category.quote: In order to deploy deep learning models to real-world settings, it is imperative that the models be memory efficient whilst simultaneously being able to capture their predictive uncertainty ... it is therefore crucial to develop memory efficient models.

secondary_sub_categories.justification: The development of more efficient computational models can contribute to policy advice and knowledge sharing by providing frameworks that guide sustainable practices in technology deployments.
